text: I still recommend this, because you do not need to lock .... Works well, but you can not do 2 sandwiches. I use whole wheat and it does not close. I still recommend this,  because you do not need to lock it to get a great results. Has one great point it shuts off and you will never burn anything. Great for mothers, make the sandwich ahead, place into this gadget, leave a note for you kids just to pluck it in, it shuts off.
